commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE bespoke editorial cover illustration for a Vantage Movers consumer moving-guide article. Wide landscape 1536x1024 composition, safe central composition usable in both 16:10 card crop and wide 16:7 article header. Premium contemporary magazine illustration, tactile paper sculpture with clean geometric forms, softly beveled edges, subtle paper grain, sophisticated studio lighting and shadows, crisp and polished. [SUBJECT] Objects must be large and instantly legible at thumbnail size, ample clean negative space, strong visual hierarchy. No people, no stock moving photographs, no generic moving-room scene, no lettering, no brand logos, no watermark. An original topic-specific composition rather than an icon sheet or collage.

posters.subject: A sculptural cutaway dollhouse floor plan viewed from above at an angle, with tiny individual household objects deliberately separated into a neat inventory grid and a large blue pencil checking a single cream checklist. Main colors cobalt, cream, a little sunflower yellow. Concept: making a room-by-room inventory before a coordinator call.

Two large distinct cream estimate sheets side by side, their rows connected by neat cobalt comparison lines, a single yellow magnifying lens highlights corresponding line items. Abstract non-readable lines only. Background pale warm blue. Concept: comparing equivalent inventories and services, not just the totals.

Three sculptural stations connected along a single elegant curved path: a small home on the left, a blue telephone and coordination desk in the center, a miniature yellow and navy freight truck on the right. Clear spatial separation. Concept: customer, coordinating broker, transporting carrier have different roles. Deep navy background.

A sculptural cobalt calculator, three stacked yellow coins, a folded route map with a winding cobalt line, and three small differently sized cream parcels form one deliberate editorial still life. No dollar amounts or readable digits. Pale mint background. Concept: distance, shipment size and services determine moving costs.

An open cream packing case divided into compartments, a blue battery, small sealed paint tin, plant and medicine bottle arranged OUTSIDE the case with separate subtle yellow question-mark tokens. No text labels, no hazard misinformation or implied definitive list. Soft coral background. Concept: check what can be packed before loading, ask about restricted items.

An elegant exploded stack of four cream document folios with cobalt tabs, a navy pen and yellow paperclip, one sheet showing a simple inventory grid, one showing a route line, one showing an abstract signature stroke. Lilac background. Concept: keeping estimate, inventory, transport paperwork and receipts organized.
